comment: The layering rule. core/ and templates/ are pure: they answer the same question the same way every time, with no framework, no storage and no network. Everything that reaches outward lives in state/, persistence/, model/ or ui/.

why.@angular/core: a pure module that injects or signals cannot be run from a node script, which is how evals/readability, evals/gate and evals/import work
why.idb: storage belongs behind persistence/, so core/ stays testable without a browser database
why.@mlc-ai/web-llm: a 1 GB model import must never be reachable from the layer that decides what a block says
